text:
### 11. Charter Review & Approval  
**Review Frequency:** Annually (or upon regulatory change)
**Approval Authority:** Board of Directors
**Last Approved:** 2026-01-15
**Next Review:** 2027-01-15  
**Changes to Charter:**
- Proposed by Head of Internal Audit or Board Audit Committee
- Approved by Board Audit Committee
- Ratified by Board of Directors
